digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler comment deduplication and manifest-driven state reclaim
propositions: Six markerless reconciler echo bodies across three tickets generate 760 excess COMMENT events and excess snapshot bytes that must be removed while preserving exactly one Jira-identity-backed echo per incident group

A manifest-driven local rewrite must change only enumerated reconciler COMMENT paths and snapshot material, leaving all other ticket state, retained event bytes, signatures, and non-target blobs byte-identical

The preparation phase must build an immutable incident manifest, create an independent off-repo backup/restore bundle, generate a local Git rewrite candidate with no push capability, and prove semantic parity and rollback before any production execution
All preparation work must remain read-only: no writer pause, lease publication, Jira comment deletion, or authoritative repository mutation until separate operator approval and quiet-window execution
